title: SetSpec
description: The set designer kitbash tier's build DATA (docs/planning/PRODUCTION-DESIGNER-PLAN.md, 'Build order' step 2): tools/build_set.py reads this and assembles a real, human-approved set from approved library kit pieces plus small hand-built primitives, generalizing tools/build_scifi_bar.py's hardcoded LAYOUT table into an authorable, diffable, reviewable spec. The designer authors DATA, not code.

canonical_id.description: The set's own canonical_id, e.g. 'set_bar_small_A' -- becomes both the joined mesh's object name and (via canonical_node) its exported node name.

name.description: Human-readable name for review UI display.

kit_root.description: Directory containing the approved kit GLB pieces layout[].piece names reference, e.g. 'assets/Ultimate Modular Sci-Fi - Feb 2021/GLB'.

base_placeholder.description: A placeholder .glb to import first -- its props/marks/cameras carry over verbatim into the real set (the grey-box-to-kitbash upgrade path). Optional: a from-scratch set omits this.

remove_from_base.description: Object names to delete from the imported base_placeholder before placement (e.g. the old grey-box set mesh and any single-piece prop being rebuilt from primitive_props instead).

layout.description: Kit-piece placements. Each entry imports kit_root/<piece>.glb once as a template (world transform baked into vertex data) and instantiates linked copies at each listed placement.

primitive_props.description: Small hand-built props as stacked box/cylinder primitives (generalizes build_scifi_bar.py's bespoke bar-counter/barstool bmesh code into data) -- for pieces the kit library doesn't have, not a general modeling system.

id.description: Canonical object name for this prop, e.g. 'prop_bar_counter_A'.

center.description: Offset from the prop's own position, not world space.

marks.description: Mark empties to add or, if the name already exists (carried over from base_placeholder), reposition. Covers both new entrance/approach marks and repositioning an existing mark for a kitbashed layout.

aim_at.description: Literal world-space point to aim at. Mutually exclusive with aim_at_mark.

aim_at_mark.description: Name of a mark (from marks[] or carried over from base_placeholder) to aim at instead of a literal point.

force_opaque.description: Kit materials sometimes import alpha-hashed with alpha near 0 (renders invisible) -- force every layout-piece material opaque, alpha 1, no backface culling.

canonical_node.description: Object/mesh name the joined layout becomes on export. Usually equal to canonical_id.

export.description: GLB is always exported; usdc additionally unless set false.
